title: Development of a biobank of adipose tissue for the implementation of research projects in the field of paediatric endocrinology and diabetology - Biobank of Adipose Tissue Ulm (BioBAT – ULM)
summary: A bank of adipose tissue samples for further research in the field of paediatric endocrinology and diabetology

interventions.name:
The following data should be collected only once for patients undergoing a planned surgical procedure that involves the routine removal of fatty tissue:
Anthropometry
medical history
if available: Laboratory parameters (clinical chemistry and blood count)

After isolation, cell biological, meta

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients undergoing a surgical procedure. 
Signed consent of the patient and/or parents
Exclusion criteria:
Lack of consent of the patient and/or parents, preoperative chemotherapy and/or radiotherapy, peritoneal carcinomatosis, liver metastases, dialysis
